text:
ara: Observability detected KMS-wrapped ciphertexts leaked in ingest logs during a partner onboarding deploy. small volume but P1 because wrapped values should never hit logs. snippet: 

ara: ```
2025-08-20T22:10:11Z INFO ingest/main.go: wrote blob id=blk_f3 wrap_ct=CpX...
```

bishal: Which key and SA?

ara: Key: projects/redwood-prod/.../keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap (v6). SA: partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com had temporary encrypter privileges.

devsec-bot: ALERT: IAM event - partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com called cloudkms.encrypt on ingest-wrap at 2025-08-20T22:10:12Z.

marta: Immediate plan: 1) revoke encrypter grants (bishal) 2) create new wrap key and enable dual-wrap in ingest for 24h (bishal + ara) 3) generate hitlist from storage logs -> gs://redwood-sec/hitlists/ingest-20250820.json (restricted) and run rewrap in small batches (owner: bishal) 4) add OPA/Gatekeeper constraint to block hostPath mounts in ingest namespaces and update helm chart 5) bump Vault audit retention for ingest to 90d and add alert for wrap frequency.

bishal: Revoking encrypter binding now and pushing a TF change to remove the binding. I'll run a staging dry-run of the rewrap script first: 

bishal: ```bash
python infra/rewrap.py \
  --hitlist gs://redwood-sec/hitlists/ingest-20250820.json \
  --src projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap \
  --dst projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-rot1 \
  --batch 100 --verify --dry-run
```

oncall: I'll schedule a 30m deploy freeze and monitor for decrypt errors. abort threshold: >0.5% failures.

ara: After rewrap, rotate any consumer tokens and CI runners that accessed the affected blobs, revoke old wrap key versions after 72h, and capture a short post-run checklist for the SEC ticket.

devsec-bot: Created ticket SEC-2225 "ingest wrapped ciphertexts leaked to logs -> rewrap + RBAC + admission control". Assignees: bishal, ara, marta. Priority: P1.

ara: Good. Please paste staging dry-run output and prod batch windows in this thread when ready.
